title: Real-valued balanced lift under permutation
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $i$ be one of the $n$ coordinates. The real-valued function associated with the lift obtained by swapping the new first coordinate with coordinate $i+1$ is the real-valued balanced lift composed with that coordinate permutation.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
